notes: Spots reported as waterlogged in heavy rain nearly every monsoon (June to September), from the BMC's pre-monsoon flood-prone lists and news reports; the BMC publishes the current list each May. Positions are the OpenStreetMap road, junction or landmark the spot is named after. radius_m is how close a route must pass to be warned. Add spots only with a source.

hotspots.name: Hindmata
hotspots.description: Low-lying junction under the Hindmata flyover in Dadar East, one of the city's best-known flooding spots.

hotspots.name: Milan Subway
hotspots.description: Road underpass below the Western Railway between Santacruz and Vile Parle; closed to traffic when flooded.

hotspots.name: King's Circle
hotspots.description: Low-lying circle at Matunga, below the King's Circle flyover.

hotspots.name: Gandhi Market
hotspots.description: Market road between King's Circle and Sion.

hotspots.name: Sion Circle
hotspots.description: Junction and subways by Sion station.

hotspots.name: LBS Marg, Kurla
hotspots.description: LBS Marg near Kalpana Cinema, Kurla West.

hotspots.name: Chunabhatti
hotspots.description: Low-lying stretch by Chunabhatti station on the Harbour line.

hotspots.name: Nair Hospital, Mumbai Central
hotspots.description: Mumbai Central junction outside BYL Nair Hospital.
